I understand why the pay is so good now, the sewers are infested with monsters! The 'vermin' and 'outlaws' are giant bloodthirsty rats and packs of angry gnolls.

Thankfully the rest of my team really knows what they're doing. Our team captain, Thomas, is an expert at this. I'm trying to learn quickly so that I'm not too much of a burden.

This is the first entry in the work journal of prison warden Kiana Smith. With all that's been going on lately, I've decided to start a journal to keep my thoughts in order.

Managing a prison half a mile underground was never going to be easy, but lately it seems like some sort of organized disruption is happening. Inmates have been acting out for no reason and then refusing to explain why.

Some of the guards are starting to say the place is haunted. I can't let my own people spread rumours, but I can't exactly blame them for being uneasy.
- Smith", "relations": ["NAME_MATCH", "REVERSE_MENTIONS", "LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 178}, {"id": "c07", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "It seems that I'm a fool as well. I assumed that the New King needed the court to submit to him willingly, but now I see that he has the power to control even those who resist him.

I blindly brought all of the strongest opposition right to his doorstep so that he could personally turn them into his slaves. Now waves of his necrotic energy are washing through the city, instantly turning most into his supplicants.

The few who still have free will are fleeing. I have chosen to stay behind to observe as best I can and look for an opening. With the magic power I have I should be able to stay hidden and safe for some time.", "relations": ["LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 176}, {"id": "c08", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "11th of Winter, 376
Dear Mom and Dad,

As if the rats weren't bad enough, deeper down there are giant crabs! One of them charged right past me and got Lee pretty badly before we killed it. Thomas says it's not my fault, but I know he's just trying to be nice to me.

Thankfully, on our way out we ran into an adventurer who had some spare sungrass salve. Lee might not have made it without that stuff.

I saw the adventurer staring at a rose before they left, they said it was a gift. Why would they risk their life down here if someone cares about them so much?

That's exactly what I'm doing isn't it? I feel like I'm in over my head.", "relations": ["LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 206}, {"id": "c09", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "85th of Autumn, 375
Dear Mom and Dad,

I told you all the hard work at the city guard would pay off. I just got promoted!

I've been invited to join a specialist team that works in the sewers. Apparently there are problems with vermin and outlaws down there, and it's our job to clear them out. It's messy work, but the sewers are warm in the winter and it pays three times as much as regular guard duty!

It's all a bit secretive though, so I can't actually send this letter. It feels weird to not write to you, so I'm going to keep writing them anyway. Maybe I can show them to you one day.

Best,
- Sonya", "relations": ["LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 204}, {"id": "c10", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "I AM KING, AHAHAHAHAAA!

They just let me do it! With hardly any convincing they agreed to let me 'share' this power with them in a great ritual. In an instant they were transformed from a chorus of mocking voices to my new court of silent subjects!

Predictably, Thymor fled like a coward at the first sign of trouble. I can already feel the resistance force he is building as well. I think I'll allow him to continue, so that he can deliver all of his conspirators right to my door!

Clearly the kingdom doesn't respect me either, I suppose I'll fix that as well.
- King of the Dwarves", "relations": ["LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 187}, {"id": "c11", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "54th of Winter, 363

A group of engineers from the city came today, saying that they're here to seal off the old entrance to the mines below. I suppose the city doesn't want to bother maintaining the passage anymore. I wasn't informed beforehand, as usual.

Their head engineer also told me some nonsense about dwarven magic leaking in from the mines. I don't believe a word of it.

The situation is under much better control with our new staff, but the root of the problem still hasn't been addressed. Something is definitely affecting the inmates here, and knocking down a few walls isn't going to change that.
- Smith", "relations": ["LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 183}, {"id": "c12", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "It is the 5th day of the 2nd month of the 33rd year of the age of magic. If an overworlder is reading this, it is sometime in Winter 264. My name is Thymor Zahir, and to the best of my knowledge I am the last surviving member of the dwarven court.

Our King is dead, replaced by one of my former colleagues who has gone mad with power. The rest of the court submitted to him, like the fools they are, and lost their free will in the process. I alone saw this coming and fled before his ritual could be completed.

The inner circle has fallen, but the New King's power has not yet reached everyone. I must mount a resistance as quickly as possible. I refuse to let our glorious civilization fall to this megalomaniac!", "relations": ["LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 221}, {"id": "c13", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "11th of Spring, 364

What the hell is the city thinking? After urgently requesting help I've heard nothing, not even an empty apology like they usually send when my requests are denied.

Meanwhile the inmates continue to get worse, and some of the guards have even started to cause trouble. Do they plan to just let this keep getting worse until we're dealing with a riot!?

Thomas has stayed reliable as ever at least. His organizational help has been invaluable, and his idea to activate those old DM-100 units was regrettable but necessary. I'm confident I can get back on top of this situation, I just need some damned support!
-Smith", "relations": ["LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 184}, {"id": "c14", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "I'VE DONE IT!

I didn't know what I might find exactly, but what I discovered out there was beyond my wildest speculation. So much power, just sitting there ready to be taken, and it's all mine!

With this none of the fools in the court will dare oppose me. I'm just giddy thinking about all the different ways I could humiliate them. Hell, why stop there, I have enough power to destroy every last one of them if I want! That might be excessive, but I mustn't take too long deciding or they'll get suspicious.

I think I'll call this great power the Amulet of Yendor!
- R.", "relations": ["LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 184}, {"id": "c15", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "23rd of Autumn, 363

Received a lovely present from Felix today. It's some sort of bright red shrub called a 'Rotberry'.

I've mentioned how dreary this place is to him before, seems he was listening. According to him this plant actually dislikes light and water, so I just have to trim the leaves back once a month or so. Trimming it must be important though, he mentioned it a dozen times in his letter.

Of course, Felix never does anything for free. He says that the seeds this thing produces are great for making wands, so naturally I owe him a few each time the plant produces some.
- Smith", "relations": ["LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 185}, {"id": "c16", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "Careful though, the mine's dangerous for a little human like you. They're pretty strong, so _be careful where you mine_ or you'll get their attention.

There's a _giant crystal_ somewhere too. It's a lot tougher, so be prepared for a fight if you start breakin' it. I'll bet smashing it will slow all the crystal growth down though, so I'll pay extra if you can do it.

Our King is dead, replaced by one of my former colleagues who has gone mad with power. The rest of the court submitted to him, like the fools they are, and lost their free will in the process. I alone saw this coming and fled before his ritual could be completed.

The inner circle has fallen, but the New King's power has not yet reached everyone. I must mount a resistance as quickly as possible. They just let me do it! With hardly any convincing they agreed to let me 'share' this power with them in a great ritual. In an instant they were transformed from a chorus of mocking voices to my new court of silent subjects!

Predictably, Thymor fled like a coward at the first sign of trouble. I can already feel the resistance force he is building as well. I think I'll allow him to continue, so that he can deliver all of his conspirators right to my door!

Clearly the kingdom doesn't respect me either, I suppose I'll fix that as well.
- King of the Dwarves", "source_id": "spd_10974fafe052c8f9aa59", "source_lang": "en", "target_lang": "zh", "source_version": 1, "metadata": {"native_context": "", "text_type": "narrative", "topic_id": "auto:entity:33037c8701cb71d3b1558d2d8ddd512bcbcdd9520d398cca95e8a5c8b867afe3"}, "max_selected": 8, "soft_token_budget": 1024, "hard_context": "[]", "candidates": [{"id": "c01", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "It is the 5th day of the 2nd month of the 33rd year of the age of magic. If an overworlder is reading this, it is sometime in Winter 264. My name is Thymor Zahir, and to the best of my knowledge I am the last surviving member of the dwarven court.

Our King is dead, replaced by one of my former colleagues who has gone mad with power. The rest of the court submitted to him, like the fools they are, and lost their free will in the process. I alone saw this coming and fled before his ritual could be completed.

The inner circle has fallen, but the New King's power has not yet reached everyone. I must mount a resistance as quickly as possible. I refuse to let our glorious civilization fall to this megalomaniac!", "relations": ["NAME_MATCH", "REVERSE_DEFINES", "LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 221}, {"id": "c02", "category": "term", "memory_kind": "term", "text": "[Unreviewed trial memory]

Source: Thymor publicly confronted me earlier today and insisted I explain my new source of power. I dismissed him as best I could, but I can feel the judging eyes of the rest of the court on me once again.

I had hoped to spend a little more time enjoying the calm before the storm, but it doesn't really matter. I've decided what I want to do. I will claim I gained my power through a new ritual, and will offer to perform it on the other warlocks and the King. Once the ritual is over, I will be king!

Thymor will protest, of course, but with this much power on offer I doubt they will listen to him!

ALL WILL BOW BEFORE ME!
- Future King of the Dwarves
Translation: 提摩今天早些时候公开质问我，坚持要我解释我新的力量来源。我尽力敷衍了他，但我能再次感受到宫廷中其他人审视的目光落在我身上。

我本希望能多花点时间享受暴风雨前的宁静，但这并不重要。我已经决定了自己要做什么。我会声称我通过一种新的仪式获得了力量，并主动提出为其他术士和国王执行这个仪式。一旦仪式完成，我就是国王了！

提摩当然会抗议，但有这么大的力量作为筹码，我怀疑他们不会听他的！

所有人都将向我俯首称臣！

Source: 80th of Spring, 362

As promised, a bunch of new recruits arrived today. It seems like the usual, a few promising ones and lots of grunts who just want the pay. Still, having all this new muscle should help a lot with our recent unruly inmates.

In a job like this it's important to know who you can trust. One new hire, Thomas, seems especially promising. I need all the help I can get right now, so if he does well I'll see about getting him promoted quickly.
- Smith
Translation: 春80日，362年

正如所承诺的，今天来了一批新兵。看起来和往常一样，几个有前途的，还有很多只想拿钱的杂兵。不过，有这些新力量应该能大大帮助我们应对最近不守规矩的囚犯。

在这种工作中，知道谁值得信任很重要。一个叫托马斯的新人看起来特别有前途。我现在需要一切能得到的帮助，所以如果他表现好，我会考虑尽快提拔他。
——史密斯", "relations": ["MEMORY_LTM"], "standalone_tokens": 324}, {"id": "c07", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "It seems that I'm a fool as well. I assumed that the New King needed the court to submit to him willingly, but now I see that he has the power to control even those who resist him.

I blindly brought all of the strongest opposition right to his doorstep so that he could personally turn them into his slaves. Now waves of his necrotic energy are washing through the city, instantly turning most into his supplicants.

The few who still have free will are fleeing. I have chosen to stay behind to observe as best I can and look for an opening. With the magic power I have I should be able to stay hidden and safe for some time.", "relations": ["NAME_MATCH", "REVERSE_MENTIONS", "LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 176}, {"id": "c08", "category": "term", "memory_kind": "term", "text": "[Unreviewed trial memory]

Source: There's a problem. Thymor was dispatched without effort, but it seems my scrounging in the outer planes did not go unnoticed.

Some... 'thing'... has been attracted to my world and is starting to force itself through at the bottom of the lower halls. To complicate things further, that is the exact location where I stored the amulet! Such a spiteful creature, why must it try to deny me my power when there is plenty out there still to take?

Despite my power though, I don't think I can just charge in and fight it. Its true power is unfathomable, but there must be some way to limit it. I WILL DEFEND MY PRIZE!
Translation: 出问题了。提摩被毫不费力地解决了，但看来我在外层位面上的搜刮并非无人注意。

某个……“东西”……被吸引到了我的世界，并开始从下层大厅的底部强行挤入。更麻烦的是，那正是我存放护符的确切位置！如此恶意的生物，外面还有那么多东西可以夺取，为什么偏要试图剥夺我的力量？

尽管我拥有力量，但我觉得我不能就这么冲进去和它战斗。它的真正力量深不可测，但一定有某种方法可以限制它。我会捍卫我的战利品！", "relations": ["MEMORY_STM"], "standalone_tokens": 368}, {"id": "c10", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "What is happening here? Even more puzzling is that activity in the upper metropolis has decreased as well. I do not know what is happening down there, but it is attracting almost all of the New King's attention.

Returning to the deep halls will be dangerous, but I must discover what is causing this change. Perhaps the New King has a weakness after all?", "relations": ["NAME_MATCH", "REVERSE_MENTIONS", "LEXICAL"], "standalone_tokens": 158}, {"id": "c11", "category": "term", "memory_kind": "term", "text": "[Unreviewed trial memory]

Source: Thomas,

You've been a great friend, so I'm doing you a favour.

When you start your shift tonight, lock and reinforce Tengu's cell, throw the key into some alcove, and get out. It doesn't matter if the other prisoners are unattended, pretty soon nobody will be able to leave this place. That freak has to stay secured though, if he escapes there's no telling what he'll do.

Tell nobody of this, and don't bother looking for me. A captain must go down with her ship.

Translation: 托马斯，

你一直是个好朋友，所以我在帮你一个忙。

今晚你上班时，把天狗的牢房锁好并加固，把钥匙扔到某个角落，然后离开。其他囚犯没人看守也无所谓，很快这里就没人能离开了。不过那个怪物必须被关好，如果他逃了，谁也不知道他会做出什么事。

这件事别告诉任何人，也别费心来找我。船长必须与她的船共存亡。
——琪安娜", "relations": ["MEMORY_STM"], "standalone_tokens": 323}, {"id": "c13", "category": "source", "memory_kind": "source", "text": "Keeping track of time has become difficult, but it has been about a week since my last entry. I'm beginning to accept that the best I can probably hope to do is document these events. Source: 23rd of Summer, 308

One of the dwarven machines came to life somehow! We were merely passing by when it charged and almost crushed two of our group with its huge metal fists. Luckily, I was carrying my wand of disintegration with me. A few well-aimed blasts from that and the beastly thing was reduced to scrap metal.

What troubles me is that we did absolutely nothing to provoke the machine. The dwarves couldn't possibly have designed the machines to be so aggressive, it's as if it was trying to ambush us!

At least I was able to offer some help to my companions for once.

What troubles me is that we did absolutely nothing to provoke the machine. The dwarves couldn't possibly have designed the machines to be so aggressive, it's as if it was trying to ambush us!

At least I was able to offer some help to my companions for once.

Today begins our four week expedition into the abandoned dwarven mines! I have been commissioned by the king himself to explore the region. My chief goals are to find any untapped natural resources and to survey the caves for a potential prison construction project.

While I am capable of defending myself, I have accepted an escort from the city guard at the king's insistence. They're a bunch of simpletons, but as long as they don't slow me down their presence is tolerable.

We are expected to clear the sewers and reach the mines by evening.
- Archibald Drummond. Archmage, southern wizarding institute.

我们预计要在傍晚前清理下水道并抵达矿坑。

Source: 23rd of Summer, 308

One of the dwarven machines came to life somehow! We were merely passing by when it charged and almost crushed two of our group with its huge metal fists. Luckily, I was carrying my wand of disintegration with me. A few well-aimed blasts from that and the beastly thing was reduced to scrap metal.

What troubles me is that we did absolutely nothing to provoke the machine. The dwarves couldn't possibly have designed the machines to be so aggressive, it's as if it was trying to ambush us!

At least I was able to offer some help to my companions for once.
- Archibald
Translation: 308年夏月23日

一台矮人机械不知怎么地突然启动了！我们只是路过，它便冲了过来，用巨大的金属拳头差点把我们队伍中的两个人砸扁。幸好我随身带着瓦解法杖。几发精准的轰击之后，那头野兽般的家伙就被打成了一堆废铁。

让我不安的是，我们完全没有做任何事去激怒那台机械。矮人不可能把机械设计得如此具有攻击性，就好像它是在试图伏击我们一样！
